top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises the physiology of GLP-1 (proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, human incretin physiology and its actions) that made incretin-based therapy of type 2 diabetes and obesity possible. The achievement is mature and clinically validated, the trio of Drucker, Holst and Mojsov fits the three-laureate limit with a clean citation scope covering the discovery rather than only the product, and no member questioned it. No award is a clearly weaker outcome.
